title: What is the best AI agent for art?
author: akzelli
selftext: I’m good at coding and coming up with ideas but terrible at art. Looking for AI help on the pixel art. Any suggestions are appreciated!

comments.author: gamerqc
comments.body: I think some people had varying success with Opus 5.5 but art/assets is probably the biggest roadblock people are facing right now. The good news is you don't need lots of assets to test your ideas.

comments.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
comments.body:

replies.author: Zeophyle
replies.body: Higgsfield is just a front end to other models. This doesn't answer answer the question, it just shills for your games and an overpriced API wrapper

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
replies.body: Is just ask to any AI, how to make it using higgsfield. But its here, GPT Image 2.5 for the art and seedance for animation.

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KSbRCSlxO7A](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KSbRCSlxO7A)

2d pixel art combat.

comments.author: One_Salty_Pigeon
comments.body: I mean my personal opinion if you have the money pay for GPT Astra and give it examples of stuff you like or even buy a pre-made set and have it build on that set. That's what I've done with Atra / Blender for 3d assets and it's done a surprisingly good job create extra assets that match my already human created (but bought) sets. Including adding textures etc etc.

replies.author: One_Salty_Pigeon
replies.body: I'd also add I love Claude as well and it's shown success in the Blender MCP but Astra absolutely was built better for the 'art' stuff more then Claude from my personal experience.

comments.author: Time_Cat_5212
comments.body:
Humble bundle and others have a fuck ton of free/cheap asset packs you can feed to any frontier model as references.

That plus screenshots make a big difference over pure text.

comments.author: ZymzAlchemy
comments.body:
I have excellent results with SOL 5.6/6.1 when paired with a proper guidance markdown and asset inventory sheet. YMMV. 

Be well, keep creating.

comments.author: BomcatTommy
comments.body: You gotta find some skills, but opus 5.5 can do it

comments.author: PotentialBet5419
comments.body: If voxel is your thing opus 5.5 can do a pretty good job it struggles with multi part models but using a good base sculpt in blender then articulating what you'd like to add on to it works to do multiple overpasses and multiple fail safes don't let the agent get stuck passing more than 2x though
